description: This file contains unit tests for the MembershipTableSnapshot class, specifically testing silo status retrieval, IAmAliveTime preservation, and behavior with unknown silos within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: MembershipTableSnapshotTests
classes.description: A test class containing unit tests for snapshot functionality related to silo membership in Orleans.

methods.name: MembershipTableSnapshot_GetSiloStatus_UnknownSilo_KnownSuccessor
